review.summary: The design-artifact contains ungrounded references to modules not present in the current system_state.json, and it falsely claims that certain services exist. These issues need to be addressed before implementation can proceed.

findings.title: Unimplemented Redis Service
findings.evidence: The artifact references 'Redis Pub/Sub' without evidence of its existence in the current system_state.json or repo files.
findings.requiredAction: Add Redis service to system_state.json and implement necessary infrastructure.

findings.title: Unimplemented Edge Functions
findings.evidence: The artifact references 'supabase/functions/radio-floor-acquire' and 'supabase/functions/radio-floor-release', which are not present in the current system_state.json or repo files.
findings.requiredAction: Create and implement these edge functions as per the design.

findings.title: Unimplemented Supabase Migration
findings.evidence: The artifact references 'radio_floor_events' table creation without evidence of its existence in the current system_state.json or repo files.
findings.requiredAction: Add 'radio_floor_events' to system_state.json and implement the necessary migration.

verificationChecks: Run `system-check.sh` to ensure all required services are present
Verify Redis instance is provisioned with expected settings using `redis-cli`
Check that edge functions exist in `supabase/functions` directory and can be executed successfully

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
